name: @usenami/funding-mcp
description: Multi-venue perpetual + HIP-3 market data for AI agents: funding rates & cross-exchange arbitrage, liquidity/slippage, open interest, volume anomalies, oracle families, and Hyperliquid HIP-3 RWA coverage (stocks/metals/oil). Free screener + paid x402 endpoints.

USENAMI_API_BASE.description: Override the Usenami API base URL (default: https://api.usenami.io)

X402_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base wallet private key (0x...) holding USDC. If set, paid tools auto-pay via x402; otherwise they return payment requirements.

tools.name: funding_screener
tools.description: FREE preview of current cross-venue perpetual funding rates across 20+ exchanges.

tools.name: funding_arb
tools.description: Cross-exchange funding-rate arbitrage candidates (ranked long/short venue pairs). Paid x402 ~$0.003.

tools.name: funding_spread
tools.description: Per-symbol funding-rate spread across all venues. Paid x402 ~$0.001.

tools.name: funding_history
tools.description: Historical funding rates for a symbol across venues. Paid x402 ~$0.005.

tools.name: orderbook_slippage
tools.description: Multi-venue execution cost / slippage for a trade size. Paid x402 ~$0.005.

tools.name: open_interest
tools.description: Current open interest for a ticker on a venue. Paid x402 ~$0.001.

tools.name: oi_delta
tools.description: Open-interest change over a lookback window (positioning shifts). Paid x402 ~$0.003.

tools.name: volume_24h
tools.description: 24h perpetual volume for a ticker on a venue. Paid x402 ~$0.001.

tools.name: volume_anomalies
tools.description: Tickers with anomalous volume spikes across venues. Paid x402 ~$0.003.

tools.name: oracle_families
tools.description: Oracle-family grouping across venues (basis-risk map). Paid x402 ~$0.001.

tools.name: rwa_coverage
tools.description: Hyperliquid HIP-3 RWA perp coverage (stocks/metals/oil/forex/indices/pre-IPO). Paid x402 ~$0.001.
